questions.question: month_key in dates.py has the same bug. Should it get the same fix?

options.label: Fix both
options.adds: Make month_key in dates.py accept unpadded dates the same way.

rewriteBeforeAnswers: Make week_key in dates.py accept unpadded dates like 2026-1-5 from the old bank export. It currently raises ValueError because it calls date.fromisoformat, which needs zero-padded parts. Done when week_key accepts 2026-1-5 and python3 run_tests.py passes.
final: Make week_key in dates.py accept unpadded dates like 2026-1-5 from the old bank export. It currently raises ValueError because it calls date.fromisoformat, which needs zero-padded parts. Done when week_key accepts 2026-1-5 and python3 run_tests.py passes. Leave month_key unchanged.
